declarations.description:
Hierarchical tree view with expansion, selection and lazy loading.

It can be authored two ways, and both produce the same DOM and the same events. Nest the rows in markup:

```html
<c2-tree expanded-items="src">
  <c2-tree-item value="src" label="src">
    <c2-tree-item value="app.ts" label="app.ts"></c2-tree-item>
  </c2-tree-item>
</c2-tree>
```

…or hand it data, which it renders into the same `c2-tree-item` elements:

```ts
tree.items = [{ value: 'src', label: 'src', children: [{ value: 'app.ts', label: 'app.ts' }] }]
```

The tree owns all state. `value` holds the selected rows, `expanded-items` the expanded ones, and every
row's `expanded`, `selected`, `indeterminate`, `level` and roving `tabindex` are written from here on each
sync — so drive those two arrays rather than the rows.

In the data-driven mode `renderItem` takes over a row's whole content, or `renderIcon`, `renderLabel` and
`renderActions` replace one part each. They are handed to Lit, so they return a Lit template or a DOM node —
not framework markup such as JSX.

`children-outline` draws a vertical rule per level of depth, the way a file explorer marks which branch each
row belongs to. It is off by default; `--c2-tree-item__guide--color` and `--c2-tree-item__guide--width` style
the rules once it is on.

Only expanded rows render their children slot, which keeps a collapsed subtree out of both layout and the
accessibility tree — though the child elements are still created. Reach for virtualization rather than this
component once a tree runs to many thousands of rows.

### Keyboard

Arrow Up and Down walk the visible rows. Arrow Right expands a collapsed branch, then moves to its first
child; Arrow Left collapses an expanded one, then moves to its parent. Home and End jump to the ends, Enter
and Space select, `*` expands every sibling of the focused row, and typing a few letters jumps to the
matching row. With `selection="multiple"`, Shift extends a range and Ctrl or Cmd toggles a single row.

members.name: renderItem
members.description:
Replaces the whole content of every row — icon, label and trailing actions together. Takes precedence over
`renderIcon`, `renderLabel` and `renderActions`. The toggle and the selection checkbox are structural and
stay. Only used in the data-driven mode; author the slots directly when the rows are written in markup.

members.name: renderLabel
members.description: Replaces the label of every row. Only used in the data-driven mode.

members.name: renderIcon
members.description: Adds an icon to every row. Only used in the data-driven mode.

members.name: renderActions
members.description: Adds trailing content to every row. Only used in the data-driven mode.

members.name: #focused
members.description: The row the roving `tabindex` currently rests on.

members.name: #anchor
members.description: Anchor for Shift-extended range selection.

members.name: #loaded
members.description: Branches whose children have already been requested, so a second expand does not refetch.

members.name: allItems
members.description: Every row in the tree, in document order, expanded or not.

members.name: visibleItems
members.description:
The rows a user can actually see and move to — every row whose ancestors are all expanded, skipping any row
`hidden` takes off the page. A filtered-out row must not stay in the keyboard order, or Arrow Down walks
onto something nobody can see.

members.name: rootItems
members.description:
The root rows, from whichever mode produced them. Data-driven rows live in this shadow root and slotted
rows in the light DOM, so both sources are read; below the root the two modes are identical and
`TreeItem.childItems` serves both.

members.name: getSelectedNodes
members.description: The rows that are currently selected, in tree order.

members.name: expand
members.description: Expands a row. Unknown or disabled values are ignored.

members.name: collapse
members.description: Collapses a row. Unknown values are ignored.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Expands a collapsed row, or collapses an expanded one.

members.name: expandAll
members.description: Expands every branch already present in the tree. Branches that load on demand are left alone.

members.name: collapseAll
members.description: Collapses every branch.

members.name: selectAll
members.description: Selects every enabled row. Only meaningful while several rows may be selected.

members.name: clearSelection
members.description: Clears the selection.

members.name: focusItem
members.description: Moves focus to a row, expanding its ancestors if needed.

members.name: reload
members.description: Drops the cached "already loaded" mark so the next expand runs `loadChildren` again.

members.name: #handleItemChange
members.description:
Rows announce themselves on connect, disconnect and identity changes. A declarative tree fires one per
row while it parses, so the resync is coalesced into a microtask — resyncing per event would be quadratic
on first paint.

members.name: #syncItems
members.description:
Writes the tree's state onto every row: depth, expansion, selection, the derived indeterminate state and
the roving `tabindex`. Rows never derive any of this themselves, which keeps one ordered walk authoritative
for rendering, ARIA and keyboard movement alike.

members.name: #derivePartial
members.description:
Values of the branches only *some* of whose descendants are selected.

Derived on every sync rather than stored, which also repairs the native input clearing its own
indeterminate flag when clicked. Disabled rows are left out of the tally entirely, so a branch whose only
unselected descendants are disabled reads as fully selected instead of being stuck half-ticked.

members.name: #descendantsOf
members.description: Every descendant of a row, expanded or not.

members.name: #loadIfNeeded
members.description: Runs `loadChildren` once per branch, showing a spinner on the row while it is in flight.

members.name: #applySelection
members.description: Applies a click or key press to the selection, honouring the range and toggle modifiers.

members.name: #applyCheck
members.description:
Ticks or clears a checkbox and carries the change to the row's relatives.

A disabled row is never added or removed by a relative: it would otherwise end up in `value` with no way
for the user to click it back out.

members.name: #renderNode
members.description:
Renders one node and, when it is expanded, its children as its own light children — the shape a
declaratively authored tree already has, so one walk serves both modes below the root.

One row of a https://github.com/code2nguyen/web-components | `c2-tree`.

Nest items to build the hierarchy — a branch's children are its own `c2-tree-item` element children:

```html
<c2-tree>
  <c2-tree-item value="src" label="src">
    <c2-tree-item value="app.ts" label="app.ts"></c2-tree-item>
  </c2-tree-item>
</c2-tree>
```

The item draws a row and nothing else: `expanded`, `selected`, `indeterminate`, `level` and the roving
`tabindex` are all written by the parent `c2-tree`, which owns the tree's state. Setting them by hand works
but is overwritten on the tree's next sync — drive the tree's `value` and `expanded-items` instead.

The children slot is only rendered while the row is expanded, so a collapsed subtree is not laid out and
stays out of the accessibility tree. The child elements themselves still exist in the DOM.

members.name: value
members.description: Identity of the row. Selection and expansion are tracked by this value, so it must be unique in the tree.

members.name: label
members.description: Text of the row. Ignored when the `label` slot is filled; falls back to `value` when empty.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Blocks selection and expansion, and takes the row out of checkbox propagation.

members.name: hasChildren
members.description: Marks a branch whose children load on demand: the toggle shows before any child exists.

members.name: href
members.description: Turns the row into a link. The whole row becomes the click target; the toggle still only expands.

members.name: target
members.description: Browsing context for `href`, e.g. `_blank`. A `_blank` row gets `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.

members.name: data
members.description: Arbitrary payload handed back on the tree's events.

members.name: expanded
members.description: Whether the children are shown. Written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: selected
members.description: Whether the row is selected. Written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: indeterminate
members.description: Whether only part of the subtree is selected. Derived and written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: loading
members.description: Whether the children are being fetched. Written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: level
members.description: Depth of the row, `0` at the root. Written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: checkboxSelection
members.description: Whether the parent `c2-tree` renders a selection checkbox. Written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: childrenOutline
members.description:
Whether to draw the indent guides. Written by the parent `c2-tree`, and reflected because the rules are
drawn in CSS and the stylesheet has to see it.

members.name: setSize
members.description: Number of siblings in this row's group, for `aria-setsize`. Written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: posInSet
members.description: 1-based index of this row among its siblings, for `aria-posinset`. Written by the parent `c2-tree`.

members.name: selectable
members.description: Whether the parent `c2-tree` tracks selection at all, so a leaf knows whether to claim `aria-selected`.

members.name: #resolvedLabel
members.description: Cached so the accessible name is not recomputed from slotted nodes on every sync.

members.name: node
members.description: The row as a TreeNode, so both authoring modes produce the same event details and renderer input.

members.name: childItems
members.description: The nested rows, in document order.

members.name: isBranch
members.description: Whether the row can be expanded — it already has children, or declares that it will load some.

members.name: resolvedLabel
members.description: The accessible name of the row, resolved from the `label` slot, the `label` attribute or `value`.

members.name: #notify
members.description:
Asks the parent tree to resync. Only identity changes qualify: the tree writes `expanded`, `selected`,
`level` and friends on every pass, so notifying on those would loop.

members.name: #syncAria
members.description:
ARIA is written imperatively on the host: `role="treeitem"` has to sit on the element the tree moves focus
to, and the `role="group"` holding the children must be a descendant of it.
